1.title: Warm-up
1.headline: Meet & Greet
1.note: Look, think and talk about greetings, names and first meetings.
questions: What words do you already know?
What can you say about this topic?

lines: Hi! My name is Emma. What’s your name?
I’m Daniel. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. How are you?

items: I am → I’m; You are → You’re

1.title: Speaking Practice
questions: Answer What’s your name? and How are you?

1.title: Listening
1.headline: Meeting Someone New
1.audio: Hi, I’m Sophie. Nice to meet you. Hi Sophie, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you too. How are you? I’m fine, thanks.
tasks: First listening: understand the main idea.
Listen again and notice key language.

1.title: Lesson Review
items: I can use key vocabulary for introductions & greetings.
I can understand and use the unit’s key sentences.
I can use the main grammar in simple communication.
I can understand the unit listening.
I can speak about the unit topic.
Final speaking challenge: use the unit language without reading the model dialogue.
